_doc: Hand-checked building facts that win over OSM tags. Only values with a public source. Match by OSM id ("osm": "w123"/"r123") or by name when no id is given. floors = storeys above ground; h = metres to roof. colour/material/roof/roofColour use OSM building:colour / building:material / roof:shape / roof:colour values. facade = window style in js/map.js (campus, glass, concrete, wash, arcade). feature = named extras drawn by js/map.js. split = cut the footprint into blocks: cuts[i] = [[x,z],[x,z]] (block 0 lies left of cut 0 seen from its first point), floors per block. Colours and materials judged from the photos listed (viewed only; nothing from them is used as a texture, all textures are generated in js/map.js). Sources written as 'Google 街景目視判斷（影像 YYYY-MM，觀看點 lat,lon，朝向）' were looked at in Google Street View only: no image was saved or used, only medium/high-confidence sightings are applied (2026-11).

buildings.name: 知行領航館
source: Google 街景目視判斷（影像 2019-05，使用者 360 照片，觀看點 24.958383,121.246160，朝東北 0~60 度）
buildings.note: 3F+B1, 5,471 m2 floor area, opened 2019, address 新中北路499號 (all per the source page). Street view (medium): about 3 storeys (top not fully in frame), box volume with white / royal-blue / light-blue panel boxes and glass bands, flat roof, a large paved forecourt; Google's place marker is at 24.9583988,121.2462024 (game x 373, z -44) with the building to its north-east. Not matched yet: OSM has no footprint named 知行領航館. Checked 2026-11: no unnamed OSM footprint within 90 m of 新中北路 east of the 465號 7-Eleven is large enough (5,471 m2 over 4 storeys needs ~1,300 m2; the largest is 735 m2), and the only footprint within 70 m of the marker is 薄膜中心 (307 m2), so build_map prints 'override not matched' until an OSM id is added as "osm".

舊校門.note: Photo Cycu_gate.jpg (described 中原大學校門): three white concrete round arches side by side, with the characters 中原大學 on plaques. The current main gate (CYCU_Gate_New.jpg) is a twisted metal sculpture. Street view (high) at this POI's position confirms the structure: a free-standing frame of three equal semicircular white concrete arches (slightly weathered) on slim columns, no deck, no roof, the middle arch over the stone-paved driveway. Scaled from cars: columns ~4-5 m, ~7-8 m overall, so colH 4.5 m (was 5.2) and slimmer 0.55 m columns (was 0.7) give 4.5 + 2.8 + 0.6 = 7.9 m. The name 舊校門 comes from the OSM POI. The width (~21 m, 5.6 m arch span) is still an estimate.

中原噴水池.note: Street view (high): a low round raised basin of light grey stone, ~12-15 m across (d 13 m; the OSM water polygon is only ~8.7 m), rim ~0.4-0.5 m high, in a round grey stone-paved plaza with concentric curved stone benches / planters, palms beside it and the beige arcade building (懷恩樓) to the north. The basin was dry or low when photographed; the game keeps shallow water and the small spray. The plaza rings and four bench arcs are drawn in js/map.js; their radii are estimates.

levels_doc: Outdoor level changes the 10 m terrain grid cannot show (js/terrain.js 'height levels'). Each site has a local frame: o = origin [x, z] in game metres, u = direction [dx, dz]; a local point [s, t] is o + s*u' + t*v' with u' = u normalised and v' = u' turned 90 degrees ((ux, uz) -> (-uz, ux)). Heights y are absolute game metres (data/terrain.json, ref 135 m) or 'ground' (terrain under that end). sink = rectangle [s0, s1, t0, t1] whose terrain posts tools/build_terrain.py pins to y (below-ground plazas). pads = raised flat areas (pts in [s, t], top y; edge: what sits on top of a wall: hedge / railing / none). stairs = from a (bottom) to b (top) [s, t], width w, heights y0 -> y1, steps (0 = ramp), rail: center / sides / none; a ramp with top (paving colour) is drawn as a sloping paved terrace and may take edge: hedge. floors = paving drawn on the terrain. js/map.js draws walls wherever an edge drops more than 0.3 m and seals them for collision; stairs and ramps are the openings.

levels.name: 泉源之谷（泉源之台）下沉廣場
source: Google 街景目視判斷（影像 2017-09，全景 3bA-kBr12kmj0mIVPop5dA 觀看點 24.9579467,121.2412731，朝 15、130、250 度）
Google 地圖使用者 360 照片 Geoforce GBV Nina（2019-06/07，24.9577169,121.2413179）
Google 衛星圖目視（標示「中原大學泉源之谷廣場」）
levels.note: Two surveys name the same plaza 泉源之谷 / 泉源之台 (probably the library's 'sunken garden'). Frame: o = the OSM plaza polygon's SW corner, u along its south edge, so the plaza is s 0..43.4, t -23..0 (t < 0 = north). Placement follows OSM (the footway area polygon and the steps way at its SE corner); the two surveys put the east stairs about 15 m further north (stairs-west: x -127..-121, z 4..20; central-axis: stairs (-120, 11), ramp (-118, 3), south wall z 17), but both are bearings and distances read off panoramas (medium / low confidence) and were not cross-checked on satellite imagery, so OSM wins until someone checks. Sunk to -0.8 (level with the lawn to the north, which both surveys say is open). South: dark brick retaining wall with a hedge on top. The terrace behind it runs to 懷恩樓 and stops 0.3 m short of its north face; it is a paved ramp following the ground along the arcade (terrain 0.1-0.2 at the west end, 0.5-0.7 at the east end), from 0.25 at the west stairs to 1.05 at the east end (road level), so the arcade is not buried. The wall is therefore 1.05 m high at the west end and 1.85 m at the east end (surveys: 1.5-2.5 m; central-axis: the east part about 1 m lower). West: two-run stairs with a centre rail up to the terrace's west landing (0.25; wall 1.05 m, 7 steps). The surveys say 2.4-2.8 m (low confidence); the terrace cannot be higher there without burying the arcade, as 懷恩樓 is drawn on the terrain. The landing's north and west sides face the lawn towards the library (-0.4..-0.55), so they get a 0.6-0.8 m wall with the hedge (not surveyed). East: wide stairs to the road level (6 steps / 1.0 m and 11 steps / 1.8 m in the two surveys; OSM step_count 6) taken as 8 x 0.156 m, 15 m wide, with the brick wall on their right; the accessible ramp north of them is a switchback in reality, drawn as one straight 1.8 m ramp (1:9), and the raised planter between ramp and stairs is a pad. The east landing (0.45) is the road level; its north end has a stone wall and railing. The terrace's west end slopes down to the footway along 懷恩樓 (assumed: not surveyed).

levels.name: 良善小門（A2 門）台階
source: Google 街景目視判斷（影像 2017-09，觀看點 24.955648,121.2419948，朝 215 度；舊版窄樓梯）
levels.note: Frame: o = the OSM steps' top end (where the campus paths meet), u down the steps towards 大仁街. Rebuilt in 2024 as the A2 gate: wide open stairs (about 7 m, 6-7 steps, 1.0-1.2 m) with a black centre rail rising north-east from a small street plaza to the campus ground. The terrain here (10 m grid, smoothed) only falls 0.36 m from the campus paths (2.06) to the street (1.72), so the full height cannot be shown without lowering the street: the stairs (4 x 0.11 m over 3 m, from 1.76) rise to a landing at 2.2, level with the campus ground to the east (良善樓 side, 2.1-2.3) and a kerb under 0.3 m from the path junction, so the way down is monotonic. The landing's north-west side runs parallel to the path west along the campus edge (1 m off it) so that path stays open, and its other low sides are sealed only where they drop more than 0.3 m. The stairs' foot stops 4.5 m short of the OSM end, behind the footway along 大仁街 (the street wall is opened in front of it), so that strip is left as terrain for the 'street plaza' (low confidence); its 2-3 steps and the A2 sign wall are not modelled.
